scope: Real React voice/status UI with fixture host; no speech accuracy or live engine claim

checks.name: Chinese UI does not silently record with only an English recognizer
available language choice contains only the actual installed language
recheck bypasses discovery cache and selects the explicit Chinese alias
explicit player language choice is visible on the recording control
direct edit checking is visible while the model is not running
applied does not imply unknown wishes were checked
closing and reopening controls rereads the real terminal result
failed status remains visible with the host reason
successful draft recovery appears independently of model running state
world switch does not retain another worlds terminal status
draft remains editable and no transcript is submitted by language settings
no microphone input focus or pointer-lock access
